cases.title: Record visited link to Global History
cases.description: Verify that when a link is visited, it is successfully recorded to the Global History.

cases.title: Record correct link after server redirect
cases.description: Verify that after a server redirect occurs, the correct final link is recorded to the Global History.

cases.title: Launch History Link in Browser Window
cases.description: Verify that clicking on a history link causes it to be launched in a browser window.

cases.title: Delete History Entry
cases.description: Verify that a History entry is successfully deleted when delete is triggered.

cases.title: Delete multiple History entries
cases.description: Verify that multiple History entries can be deleted and are no longer displayed.

cases.title: Clear Global History
cases.description: Verify that Global History is successfully cleared when the clear action is triggered.

cases.title: Group history items by Day
cases.description: Verify that history items are successfully grouped by Day when the Day grouping option is selected.

cases.title: Group history items by Site
cases.description: Verify that history items are successfully grouped by Site when the Site grouping option is selected.

cases.title: Group history items by None
cases.description: Verify that history items are displayed without any grouping when the None option is selected.

cases.title: Sort History per Column
cases.description: Verify that history is sorted per column.

cases.title: Reverse-Sort History per Column
cases.description: Verify that history is reverse-sorted per column.

cases.title: Resize History Columns
cases.description: Verify that history columns are resizable to show or hide more of entries.

cases.title: Show History Columns
cases.description: Verify that history columns are shown when selected.

cases.title: Hide History Columns
cases.description: Verify that history columns are hidden when deselected.

cases.title: Re-visit recently visited sites via Back and Forward button dropdown menu
cases.description: Verify that recently visited sites can be re-visited by selecting them from the Back and Forward button dropdown menu.

cases.title: Create new empty session history file for a new browser window
cases.description: Verify that a new, empty session history file is created when opening a new browser window.

cases.title: Create new empty session history file for a browser restart
cases.description: Verify that a new, empty session history file is created upon a browser restart.

opinions.feedback: The proposed test cases cover all stated requirements and their explicit scenarios comprehensively without any blockers or redundant excesses.
All requirements and their explicitly described operations, grouping options, column states, and lifecycle scenarios are fully covered by the test cases. No blockers or coverage gaps found.

analysis.analysis: R-073: Single straightforward acceptance criterion. Normal test scenario only. Atomic behavior: Trigger is visiting a link; expected outcome is recording the visited link to the Global History. R-074: Single straightforward acceptance criterion. Normal test scenario only. Atomic behavior: Trigger is a server redirect; expected outcome is recording the correct link to the Global History. R-075: Single straightforward acceptance criterion. Normal test scenario only. Atomic behavior: Trigger is clicking on a history link; expected outcome is launching the link in a browser window. R-076: Single straightforward acceptance criterion. Normal test scenario only. Atomic behavior: Trigger is deleting a History entry; expected outcome is the entry being deleted. R-077: Single straightforward acceptance criterion. Normal test scenario only. Atomic behavior: Trigger is deleting multiple History entries; expected outcome is the entries being deleted and no longer displayed. R-078: Single straightforward acceptance criterion. Normal test scenario only. Atomic behavior: Trigger is clearing Global History; expected outcome is the Global History being cleared. R-079: Multiple distinct behaviors. Normal test scenarios for grouping by Day, Site, and None. Atomic behaviors: Trigger selection of Day, Site, or None grouping; expected outcome is history items being grouped accordingly. R-080: Multiple distinct behaviors. Normal test scenarios for sorting and reverse-sorting per column. Atomic behaviors: Trigger sorting and reverse-sorting per column; expected outcome is history being sorted or reverse-sorted per column. R-081: Single straightforward acceptance criterion. Normal test scenario only. Atomic behavior: Trigger resizing history columns; expected outcome is showing/hiding more of entries. R-082: Multiple distinct behaviors. Normal test scenarios for showing and hiding columns. Atomic behaviors: Trigger showing and hiding history columns; expected outcome is columns being shown and hidden. R-083: Single straightforward acceptance criterion. Normal test scenario only. Atomic behavior: Trigger re-visiting via Back and Forward button dropdown menu; expected outcome is recently visited sites being re-visited. R-084: Multiple distinct behaviors. Normal test scenarios for a new browser window and for a restart. Atomic behaviors: Trigger creating a new browser window or a restart; expected outcome is a new, empty session history file being created.
